title: Explore the evidence behind sponsorship.
intro: Search stable employer identifiers in public LCA disclosures. Understand the period, wages and limits before comparing.
searchHint: Search a full identifier or a fragment. Company-name search is unavailable in this public projection.
resultHint: Up to 12 results, ordered by observed application count. These are identifiers, not current company names.
more: More results exist. Enter a longer identifier to narrow your search.
inputError: Use an identifier of up to 80 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; UNKNOWN is not an individual employer.
unavailable: Data is temporarily unavailable. Retry this page later. No substitute data is shown.
full: Comparison holds up to 3 identifiers. Remove one first.
choose: Choose an employer from search to begin a comparison.
compareHint: Rows remain separate by fiscal year and identity-history status. Wage medians describe each observed group; differences can reflect occupation and geography mix, not a like-for-like pay comparison.
disclaimer: LCA applications are not approvals and do not guarantee that a role offers sponsorship.
coverage: Coverage: archived FY2024 and FY2025 Q4 releases. Observed cases are not full-year totals or a trend. Hourly × 2080, weekly × 52, biweekly × 26, monthly × 12; annual wage units are USD.
identity: Identifiers represent entity resolution, not verified present-day names. History status is preserved as a source code: uncertain or missing historical matches do not establish a current employer identity. UNKNOWN is excluded from individual results.
missing: Missing or suppressed wages remain unavailable. No OEWS benchmark or posting trend is inferred on these pages.
parquet: Verified public Parquet snapshot via Cube REST
snowflake: Explicit live Snowflake source via Cube REST (trial availability applies)
fixture: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — not real employer evidence
freshness: Server data cache revalidates periodically; this does not refresh the underlying source snapshot.
notFoundHint: Check the identifier or return to search.
caption: LCA application evidence by employer, fiscal period and identity history
unresolved: Unresolved identity: {count} observed LCA applications remain in the UNKNOWN aggregate, outside individual employer results.
metaDescription: Explore public LCA disclosures with source, period and identity context.
